اعلولي (form XII)
# اُعْلُولِيَ (uʕlūliya) /uʕ.luː.li.ja/: third-person masculine singular past passive of اِعْلَوْلَى (iʕlawlā)
# اِعْلَوْلِي (iʕlawlī) /iʕ.law.liː/: second-person feminine singular imperative of اِعْلَوْلَى (iʕlawlā)
